description.fallback: Dio goes crashing through the window behind him after being shot multiple times by the police. He lays on the ground outside surrounded by broken glass; presumed dead, his face is still covered by the Stone Mask. Inside, Jonathan holds his dying father.

intro.fallback: Dio goes crashing through the window behind him after being shot multiple times by the police.
He lays on the ground outside surrounded by broken glass; presumed dead, his face is still covered by the Stone Mask.
Inside, Jonathan holds his dying father.

text.fallback: Head out: Youth with Dio, Part 1

outro.fallback: It is too late for the man, as a hand swoops down from outside the window and rips the top of the inspector's head off.
It is Dio, who, unbeknownst to everyone present, has transformed himself from a human to a Vampire.
